article.headline: Hyder scores 19, Cal Poly knocks off Long Beach State 78-69
article.description: — Jarred Hyder scored 19 points as Cal Poly beat Long Beach State 78-69 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Hyder scores 19, Cal Poly knocks off Long Beach State 78-69

categories.description: Long Beach State Beach @ Cal Poly Mustangs

event.description: Long Beach State Beach @ Cal Poly Mustangs

keywords: Long Beach State Beach @ Cal Poly Mustangs
article.story: SAN LUIS OBISPO, Calif. -- — Jarred Hyder scored 19 points as Cal Poly beat Long Beach State 78-69 on Saturday night. Hyder also contributed three steals for the Mustangs (7-14, 1-8 Big West Conference). Mac Riniker finished 7 of 12 from the field to add 16 points. Owen Koonce had 15 points and shot 7 for 14, including 1 for 3 from beyond the arc. The Mustangs broke a seven-game losing streak. Devin Askew led the Beach (7-14, 3-6) in scoring, finishing with 35 points, seven rebounds and four steals. TJ Wainwright added 12 points for Long Beach State. Austin Johnson also recorded six points and nine rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
